Vendor setup checklist (what procurement will ask for):
• Completed vendor intake form (their template)
• W-9 (attached)
• Bank details for ACH (we provide redacted CSV; full wiring instructions available after NDA if necessary)
• Primary invoice recipient + contact (billing@redwoodinference.com)
• Signed commercial terms (we can supply a one-page SOW for pilot with standard terms)

Attachments we should send back to them: redwood_vendor_packet_v1.pdf, W-9_Redwood_Inference.pdf, bank_details_redwood.csv.

Timeline expectation: once vendor intake form + W-9 + bank stub received, procurement typically verifies and issues PO within 7–12 business days for standard SRM. If Finex insists on marketplace, add 10–15 business days to get listed/subscribed depending on their internal procurement.

I'll draft a one-page pilot SOW and a DocuSign link this afternoon; Rachel — happy to be introduced to procurement directly if they want a walkthrough.
